source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains distress, tears, denied aim, and love.
key_decisions.before: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears—not so that you might be grieved, but so that you might know the love that I have abundantly for you.
key_decisions.after: For I wrote to you through much affliction and anguish of heart, with many tears—not to cause you sorrow, but so that you might know the abundant love I have especially for you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears—not so that you might be grieved, but so that you might know the love that I have abundantly for you.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps Paul's qualification rather than universalizing the harm.
key_decisions.before: But if someone has caused sorrow, he has caused it not to me alone, but in some measure—not to overstate it—to all of you.
key_decisions.after: But if anyone has caused sorrow, he has not caused sorrow to me alone, but—to avoid overstating it—to some extent to all of you.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But if anyone has caused sorrow, he has caused it not to me alone, but in some measure—not to overstate it—to all of you.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves the communal action and its sufficiency.
key_decisions.before: This punishment by the majority is enough for such a one,
key_decisions.after: The punishment imposed by the majority is enough for such a person.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: This punishment by the majority is enough for such a one,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the reversal and danger of engulfing grief.
key_decisions.before: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive and comfort him, lest he be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
key_decisions.after: So now, instead, you should forgive and comfort him, so that he is not overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive and comfort him, lest he be overwhelmed by excessive sorrow.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the conditional qualification and Christward setting.
key_decisions.before: Anyone whom you forgive, I also forgive. Indeed, what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, has been for your sake in the presence of Christ,
key_decisions.after: Anyone you forgive, I also forgive. Indeed, whatever I have forgiven—if I had anything to forgive—I have forgiven for your sake in the presence of Christ,
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: Anyone whom you forgive, I also forgive. Indeed, what I have forgiven, if I have forgiven anything, has been for your sake in the presence of Christ,

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the potentially captive triumph image and fragrance metaphor.
key_decisions.before: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ and manifests through us the fragrance of the knowledge of him in every place.
key_decisions.after: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in Christ's triumphal procession and through us spreads everywhere the fragrance of knowing him.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ and manifests through us the fragrance of the knowledge of him in every place.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the stark double outcome and closing question.
key_decisions.before: to the one a fragrance from death to death, to the other a fragrance from life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?
key_decisions.after: to some, an aroma from death leading to death; to others, an aroma from life leading to life. And who is sufficient for these things?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: to the one a fragrance from death to death, to the other a fragrance from life to life. And who is sufficient for these things?

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves commercial accusation, sincerity, source, and accountability.
key_decisions.before: For we are not like so many, peddling the word of God; but as from sincerity, but as from God, in the presence of God, we speak in Christ.
key_decisions.after: For we are not like the many who peddle God's word. Instead, we speak in Christ with sincerity, as people sent from God and standing before God.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For we are not like so many, peddling the word of God; but as from sincerity, but as from God, in the presence of God, we speak in Christ.
